brief:
An Israeli nonprofit organization is recruiting British citizens to relocate to Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. Shivat Zion is conducting recruitment tours across the United Kingdom, beginning in Glasgow this Sunday before moving to Manchester, Birmingham, and London.

The organization aims to encourage Britons to settle in the newly built communities in the occupied territory. The tours mark an expansion of efforts to attract diaspora Jews to the settlements, which are considered illegal under international law.

title: Israeli nonprofit recruits British settlers for West Bank move
